O.outcome_detail: reported motivations and reasons for completing or not completing homework corrections

cells.quote: Of the students who did not complete HWCs, a plurality reported that they had intended to but forgot; this was closely followed by limitations on time. cells.note: The study also reports that all students who completed HWCs were at least partially motivated by improving their grade, while a notable portion reported motivations related to understanding content and learning from mistakes.

result.effect: 64% (81/127) used at least once; median usage 1.0 log-on; maximum 13 log-ons

cells.quote: From the log files of the HWA, we know that 81 of the 127 (64%) respondents in the intervention group used the HWA at least once, while 49% (40/81) of these used the application only once. The respondent that used the HWA most frequently used it 13 times during the intervention period of 12 weeks. The median number of times HWA was used was 1.0.
cells.note: Usage was reported descriptively for respondents allocated to the intervention group; the study text does not report a comparative usage effect against the waiting-list group.
